name: teams
description: Read and send Microsoft Teams chats and watched-team channels via the Teams internal REST services (the same services Teams web uses), with bearer tokens sniffed from the live Teams web session. List unread DMs / group chats / meeting chats / watched-team channels, read a conversation's messages, and send messages - no DOM hydration. Mark-read and reply drafting are browser-driven (handled by the drainer worker and the message-draft skill).
